description: The purpose of this solicitation amendment is to provide a revised AF3052 for construction cost breakdown in connection with Project Number PNQS 25-5418 Repair Electrical Systems Airfield at Maxwell AFB, Alabama.  The Proposal due date/time has been extended from Monday, 13 Apr 2026/12:00pm (CDT) for two (02) addtional days to Wednesday, 15 Apr 2026/12:00p, (CDT).
